Sex offender convicted of murdering two women after release

Simon Levy, a convicted sex offender, has been found guilty of murdering two women and raping a third. Levy was arrested for murder and subsequently convicted. The coverage indicates he was a "sex offender freed after murder arrest" and a "serial sex attacker" who was "left free to kill twice before being brought to justice." The convictions followed "police failings" that allowed him to remain at large.
